Reading change: the basmalah is not detachable ornament; it anticipates the final command by pre-assigning the action to God before triumph can be misclaimed.

Abductive move: I infer that the later entry is the functional test of the earlier opening. Reading change: the ayah reads less as an abstract announcement of victory and more as the moment when a closed boundary becomes passable.
